II.}}</noinclude>suppose, vvhereas it is the third houre of the day: {{verse|chapter=2|verse=16}}† But this is it that vvas said by the Prophet Ioël, {{verse|chapter=2|verse=17}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Ioel. 2, 28.''}}* ''And it shal be, in the last daies (saith our Lord) of my Spirit I vvil powre out vpon al flesh: and your sonnes and your daughters shal prophecie, and your yong men shal see visions, and your auncients shal dreame dreames''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=18}}† ''And vpon my seruants truely, and vpon my handmaides vvil I povvre out in those daies, of my Spirit, and they shal prophecie'': {{verse|chapter=2|verse=19}}† ''and I vvil giue vvonders in the heauen aboue, and signes in the earth beneath, bloud, and fire, and vapour of smoke''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=20}}† ''The sunne shal be turned into darkenes, and the moone into bloud, before the great and manifest day of our Lord doth come''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=21}}† ''And it shal be, euery one vvhosoeuer calleth vpon the name of our Lord, shal be saued''.⊣

{{verse|chapter=2|verse=22}}† Ye men of Israël heare these vvordes, {{sc|Iesvs}} of Nazareth a man approued of God among you, by miracles and vvonders and signes vvhich God did by him in the middes of you, as you knovv: {{verse|chapter=2|verse=23}}† this same, {{sup|‖}} by the determinate counsel and prescience of God being deliuered, you by the handes of vvicked men haue crucified and slaine. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=24}}† vvhom God hath raised vp {{sup|‖}} loosing the sorovves of hel, according as it vvas impossible that he should be holden of it. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=25}}† For Dauid saith concerning him, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 15, 8.''}}* ''I foresavv the Lord in my sight alvvaies: because he is at my right hand that I be not moued''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=26}}† ''For this, my hart hath been glad and my tongue hath reioyced: moreouer my flesh also shal rest in hope''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=27}}† {{sup|‖}} ''because thou vvilt not leaue my soul '' {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ who but an infidel (saith S. Augustine) wil deny Christ to haue descended to Hel? ''ep. 99''.}}∷ ''in hel, nor giue thy Holy one to see '' {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ As his soul suffered no paines in Hel, so neither did his body take any corruption in the graue.}}∷ ''corruption''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=28}}† ''Thou hast made knovven to me the vvaies of life: thou shalt make me ful of ioyfulnes vvith thy face''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=29}}† Ye men, brethren, let me boldly speake to you of the Patriarch Dauid: that {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''3. Reg. 2, 10.''}}* he died, and vvas buried: and his sepulchre is vvith vs vntil this present day. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=30}}† VVhereas therfore he vvas a Prophet, and knevv that by an othe {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 131, 11.''}}* ''God had svvorne to him that of the fruite of his loynes there should sit vpon his seate'': {{verse|chapter=2|verse=31}}† forseeing he spake of the resurrection of Christ, for neither vvas he left in hel, neither did his flesh see corruption. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=32}}† This {{sc|Iesvs}} hath God raised againe, vvhereof al vve are vvitnesses.

{{verse|chapter=2|verse=33}}† Being exalted therfore by the right hand of God, and hauing receiued of his father the promisse of the Holy Ghost, he hath povvred out {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''`this gift vvhich''}}`this vvhom' you see and heare. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=34}}† For Dauid ascended not into heauen: but he saith, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 109, 1.''}}* ''Our Lord hath said to my Lord, sit on my right hand'', {{verse|chapter=2|verse=35}}† ''vntil I make thine enemies the footestoole of thy feete''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=36}}† Therfore let al the house of Israël know most certainly that God hath made him both Lord, and {{sc|Christ}}, this {{sc|Iesvs}}, vvhom you haue crucified.

{{verse|chapter=2|verse=37}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Contrition.}}∷ And hearing these things, they were compuncte in hart, and said to Peter and to the rest of the Apostles, Vvhat shal<noinclude>{{rh|||vve}}</noinclude>
